cohort: 126 neonates in a neonatal care unit who showed signs at birth or had risk factors for early-onset infection.
finding: Umbilical cord blood procalcitonin (PCT) levels were significantly higher in neonates with early-onset infection (EOI), suggesting PCT is a valuable marker for EOI diagnosis with an optimal threshold value of 0.142 ng/ml.
gest_age: Both term and preterm neonates were included, with separate optimal cut-off values determined for each group.
